What the score means

The score is a 0–1 rating of how established and readable an outlet is; higher is better. It blends:

  • How widely it’s read — its audience reach in the country.
  • Language match — how well it matches the country’s main language.
  • Agrees with rankings — overlap with other news rankings.
  • Publishes fresh news — its feed works and carries recent stories.

We find each outlet’s feed from a direct feed, through Google News, or through search; that is the “found” note on each outlet.
